topic: Quarantine counts in orch status are shown to every caller
detail: SP-031.1.a1 says agent callers see counts only for their own space and public ones. SP-031 narrows its own counts (chunks per space, relabel totals, conflicts) that way, but SP-028's quarantine totals (SpacesStatus.quarantine: sources and chunks, never a source) stay open to every caller, as SP-028 designed and tested (TestStatusCountsQuarantine). SP-031 reads a1's counts as per-space counts, which a quarantine total is not. Options: (a) keep: a quarantine total names no space; (b) send quarantine totals to Orch.app only, as SP-031 does for conflicts. Recommendation: (a), unless the user wants status to say nothing about content a session cannot read.
